name: Sentry
description: Sentry web API for managing organizations, teams, projects and exporting error-monitoring data.
auth_notes: Sources reference an authentication token tutorial and an Authentication page but do not state the credential format or how it is sent.
gate_detail: The API reference and token tutorial are public, but sources do not state plan requirements or whether a free account can create tokens. Partnership platform is a separate sales-led path for provisioning.
api_scope: Web API (v0) for account-level resources such as organizations and teams, plus managing and exporting data; region-specific domains such as us.sentry.io and de.sentry.io.
mcp_notes: Provided MCP pages cover monitoring of MCP servers with Sentry SDKs, not a Sentry-published MCP server.
blocker_detail: Credential creation steps and plan requirements are not stated in the supplied sources.

evidence.quote: The Sentry web API is used to access the Sentry platform programmatically.
Tutorial: Create a Sentry Authentication Token
You can use the APIs to manage account-level resources, like organizations and teams, as well as manage and export data.
Set up the necessary API credentials and configurations
Sentry MCP Monitoring helps you track and debug Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations using our supported SDKs and integrations.

issues: Auth scheme and token delivery are not described in the sources.
Free-tier access to tokens is not stated.
Sandbox appears only as a menu item.
Partnership platform is for platform partners, not the general API.
